title: Police Arrest Weirdo In Library After Harassing Woman
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On August 3rd, 2023. Officers were called to a library in reference to a man who was harassing a woman and calling her racial slurs. When the officer approached the man, he could smell the odour of alcohol coming from him and he also saw an open container of beer in an empty can .This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
